name: Florian Ronsse
bio: The planner. Florian handles every Disney detail from park days and cruise itineraries to Lightning Lane strategy and late-night snack runs. He keeps the group moving and the magic intact.

name: Megan
bio: If it is edible and Disney-related, Megan has already researched it. She owns the restaurant reservations, the must-try snacks, and the honest food takes that the rest of us trust.

name: Elias
bio: Florian’s brother and the reliable third vote. Elias brings steady energy, strong opinions on thrills, and is always ready for one more ride or one more dessert.

name: Lotte
bio: Always up for the next adventure. Lotte brings the energy, the jokes, and is usually the first one to suggest one more snack or one more ride.

name: Thibeau
bio: The steady one in the group. Thibeau keeps the vibe calm, has strong opinions on the best rides, and is always ready when the plans change.
